patterns.note: Consistent use of full-width sections with content centered or arranged in clear multi-column grids (3-column for features/articles, 2-column for text/list).
Prominent use of a clean, modern sans-serif for all text, with large, bold headings for impact and smaller, lighter text for body content, often paired with uppercase labels for section titles.
A restrained palette of off-white backgrounds, dark charcoal text, and a distinctive bright lime green as the primary accent and call-to-action color.
A sticky header remains visible at the top of the viewport, combined with a subtle background parallax effect in the hero section where the image scrolls slower than the foreground content.
Sections are clearly delineated by generous vertical spacing and subtle changes in background color (white to light gray), often featuring large, impactful numbers for statistics.

technique_notes: A fixed header element is positioned at the top of the viewport, maintaining navigation visibility throughout the scroll.
The hero section employs a background image that scrolls at a slower rate than the foreground content, creating a subtle parallax depth effect.

Content sections are structured using a grid system, typically in three columns for features or articles, and two columns for descriptive text paired with bulleted lists, ensuring consistent alignment and readability.

design_tokens.type_scale: Large, bold sans-serif headings (approx 3-4x body size) provide strong hierarchy, complemented by a clean, readable body text and small, uppercase labels for section titles.
design_tokens.radius: Subtle rounded corners (small radius) are applied consistently to buttons, image cards, and input fields, softening the overall aesthetic without being overly playful.
design_tokens.spacing: Balanced to airy, with generous vertical padding between major sections and within content blocks, creating a sense of openness and clear content separation.

standout: The site's distinctive use of a vibrant, almost neon, lime green as its sole accent color against a clean, minimal backdrop immediately draws attention to key actions and information, making the site feel fresh and energetic while maintaining a professional and authoritative tone. The large, impactful numbers in the stats section also contribute to its unique character.
